deviceUnresponsiveHint: Your computer isn't answering right now. Retrying automatically.
connectStep1: Install and open {{appName}} on your computer
connectStep2: Sign in with the same account as your phone
connectStep3: Under Settings → Remote Access, turn on "Allow same-account devices to control this computer"
cloudTeaserCopy: Once it launches, the mobile app works on its own, no computer needed.
cloudReadyCopy: No computer needed — wake the cloud to start right away.

cloudInstance.wakeFailed: Failed to wake the cloud instance. Try again.
cloudInstance.updateRolledBack: The last update failed and was rolled back automatically.
cloudInstance.autoUpdateHint: When a new release is available, the cloud instance updates automatically while idle or sleeping.
cloudInstance.updateFailed: Cloud instance update couldn't start. Try again.
cloudInstance.autoUpdateFailed: The cloud instance auto-update setting couldn't be saved. Try again.
cloudInstance.noReleaseAvailable: No release is available yet. Refresh and try again later.
cloudInstance.updateConfirmDescription: Updating restarts the cloud instance and interrupts any running tasks.
cloudInstance.stopFailed: Failed to sleep the cloud instance. Try again.
cloudInstance.deleteFailed: Failed to delete the cloud instance. Try again.
cloudInstance.deleteConfirmDescription: The cloud data will be deleted and cannot be recovered. The corresponding device will also be removed.

authFailedHint: Your sign-in has expired. Sign out and sign in again.
replacedHint: This device connection was replaced elsewhere. Reconnecting now.
tooManyConnectionsHint: Too many devices are online for this account. Disconnect another device and try again.
versionMismatchHint: This app version is incompatible with the service. Update to the latest version and try again.
unstableHint: Connection keeps dropping and reconnecting — check the network, or restart the app if it persists.
